title: GuetaQuant: Open-Source Quantitative Finance Tools & Empirical Falsification Research
description: Comprehensive open-source suite of 44 quantitative finance tools (MQL5, Pine Script v6, cTrader C#) and negative-first empirical research frameworks evaluating technical trading strategies against Bailey & López de Prado Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR) and Combinatorially Symmetric Cross-Validation (CSCV) protocols.
